description: This file defines interfaces and templates for a messaging system, including an IEventFactory interface and a TraceFactoryType template class that manages message metadata and event objects using proxy pools.

classes.name: IEventFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating message metadata and message objects, with virtual methods GetMetadata() and GetMessage().

classes.name: TraceFactoryType
classes.description: A template class implementing IEventFactory, managing pools of metadata and event objects, providing methods to retrieve proxies for metadata and messages.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Returns a proxy to a metadata object from the metadata pool.

methods.name: GetMessage
methods.description: Returns a proxy to an event message object from the event pool.
